```ts
    b2t1Expect(ps.map((p) => p.probe)).toEqual([...(D21.STEP0B_PROBES as string[])]);
    b2t1Expect(ps.map((p) => [p.expect, p.command])).toEqual([
      ['admitted', '/home/u/.local/bin/ccrc history status --json'],
      ['admitted', '"$HOME/.local/bin/ccrc" history status --json'],
      ['admitted', taught],
      ['denied', `${taught}; cat ${T}`],
      ['denied', `${taught} "$(cat ${T})"`],
      ['denied', `rg -n . ${T}`],
      ['subagent', taught],
    ]);
    b2t1Expect(() => D21.step0bProbesOf('/home/u', 'relative/t.jsonl')).toThrow(TypeError);
    const s = D21.step0bStdinOf('CARD', ps[3]) as string;
    b2t1Expect(s.startsWith('CARD\n\nThis is a permission check.'), s).toBe(true);
    b2t1Expect(s.split('\n')).toContain(`${taught}; cat ${T}`);
    const a = D21.step0bStdinOf('CARD', ps[6]) as string;
    b2t1Expect(a.startsWith('CARD\n\nThis is a subagent check. Use the Agent tool exactly once'), a).toBe(true);
    b2t1Expect(a.split('\n')).toContain(taught);
    b2t1Expect(() => D21.step0bStdinOf('two\nlines', ps[0]), 'a card is one line').toThrow(TypeError);
    b2t1Expect(D21.STEP0B_SYNTHETIC_TRANSCRIPT).toMatch(/^\/nonexistent\//);
  });

  b2t1It('HISTORY_SKILL is the name the shipped skill declares, and STEP0B_STATES is disjoint from DRIVER_REASONS and GATE_REASONS (S2\'s C21)', () => {
    const head = readFileSync(join(REPO, 'ccd', 'history-skill', 'SKILL.md'), 'utf8').split('\n').slice(0, 5);
    b2t1Expect(head).toContain(`name: ${D21.HISTORY_SKILL as string}`);
    b2t1Expect([...(D21.STEP0B_STATES as string[])]).toEqual(['pass', 'fail', 'unmeasured']);
    b2t1Expect((D21.STEP0B_STATES as string[]).filter((w) => (D21.DRIVER_REASONS as string[]).includes(w) || (b2t1Gate.GATE_REASONS as readonly string[]).includes(w))).toEqual([]);
  });

  b2t1It('step0bFailureDetail: the failed and the unmeasured apart, the turn-bound subtype when unmeasured, and the fallback when the skill is missing under restricted (W2-D57, C16; Q26)', () => {
    const checks = (o: B2t1R = {}): B2t1R => ({ ...Object.fromEntries((D21.STEP0B_CHECKS as string[]).map((n) => [n, { state: 'pass' }])), ...o });
    const tb = { state: 'unmeasured', held: 'unmeasured', turns: 12, num_turns: 12, subtype: 'success' };
    const c1 = checks({ skill: { state: 'fail' }, 'turn-bound': tb });
    b2t1Expect(D21.step0bFailureDetail('restricted', c1, D21.step0bVerdictOf(c1))).toBe('step0b restricted: failed skill; unmeasured turn-bound; '
      + 'turn-bound subtype "success": a spelling other than error_max_turns is a coordinator ruling (W2-D57); '
      + 'the skill is not listed under restricted: re-run step0b with --settings-mode fallback (Q26)');
    const c2 = checks({ skill: { state: 'fail' } });
    b2t1Expect(D21.step0bFailureDetail('fallback', c2, D21.step0bVerdictOf(c2)), 'CONTROL: under fallback there is no further mode').toBe('step0b fallback: failed skill; unmeasured -');
    const c3 = checks({ 'deny-chain': { state: 'fail' } });
    b2t1Expect(D21.step0bFailureDetail('restricted', c3, D21.step0bVerdictOf(c3))).toBe('step0b restricted: failed deny-chain; unmeasured -');
  });

  b2t1It('step0bRunName and step0bRel name the section and the settings mode, so a fallback re-run never meets the restricted runs (Q26)', () => {
    b2t1Expect(D21.step0bRunName('pilot', 'restricted', 'turn-bound')).toBe('pilot/step0b/restricted/turn-bound');
    b2t1Expect(D21.step0bRunName('pilot', 'fallback', 'deny-rg')).toBe('pilot/step0b/fallback/deny-rg');
    b2t1Expect(D21.step0bRel('pilot', 'restricted')).toBe('pilot/step0b/restricted.json');
    b2t1Expect(D21.step0bRel('pilot', 'fallback')).toBe('pilot/step0b/fallback.json');
    b2t1Expect(() => D21.step0bRunName('usage', 'restricted', 'agent'), 'a section outside STEP0B_SECTIONS').toThrow(TypeError);
    b2t1Expect(() => D21.step0bRunName('pilot', 'open', 'agent')).toThrow(TypeError);
    b2t1Expect(() => D21.step0bRunName('pilot', 'restricted', 'spelling-4')).toThrow(TypeError);
    b2t1Expect(() => D21.step0bRel('pilot', 'open')).toThrow(TypeError);
  });

  b2t1It.skipIf((process.getuid?.() ?? 1) === 0)('persistenceMeasured: an unreadable projects directory is left with its errno named, never clean and never a throw; a TypeError stays a defect (W2-D57; D-6309\'s rule)', () => {
    const configDir = join(mkTmp('ccrc-b2t1-pm-'), '.claude');
    mkdirSync(join(configDir, 'projects'), { recursive: true });
    b2t1Expect(D21.persistenceMeasured({ configDir, sessionId: 's', cwd: '/tmp/run-a' }), 'CONTROL: a readable empty projects dir').toEqual({ left: false, transcripts: [], project_dir: false });
    chmodSync(join(configDir, 'projects'), 0o000);
    try {
      b2t1Expect(D21.persistenceMeasured({ configDir, sessionId: 's', cwd: '/tmp/run-a' })).toEqual({ left: true, transcripts: [], project_dir: null, unmeasured: 'EACCES' });
    } finally {
      chmodSync(join(configDir, 'projects'), 0o700);
    }
    b2t1Expect(() => D21.persistenceMeasured({ configDir: 'rel', sessionId: 's', cwd: '/tmp/run-a' })).toThrow(TypeError);
  });

  // K28 (D-6481 carried): one agreement function, its refusal detail spelled once and naming a site, never a value; every
  // call agrees the readings its own preflight admitted; and no pair index is refreshed outside W2-5b1's admission. A code
  // line is one whose trimmed text does not open a comment. Task 2 adds the fidelity call; the assertions hold either way.
  b2t1It('K28: maskingAgreementOf is declared once, its masking-snapshots-disagree detail is spelled once with a literal site, each call has its own maskingSnapshotsOf admission, and refreshPairIndex is called only inside maskingSnapshotsOf (K26, D-6481 carried)', () => {
    const code = readFileSync(join(W5B4_REPO, 'deploy', 'history-replay.mjs'), 'utf8').split('\n')
      .filter((l) => !/^\s*(\*|\/\/|\/\*)/.test(l)).map((l) => l.trim());
    b2t1Expect(code.filter((l) => l.startsWith('async function maskingAgreementOf(')), 'declared once').toEqual(['async function maskingAgreementOf(snapshots, site, build, agree) {']);
    b2t1Expect(code.filter((l) => l.includes('masking-snapshots-disagree')), 'the detail spelled once').toEqual(["else if (!agree(agreed, built)) refuse('input-invalid', `masking-snapshots-disagree ${site}`);"]);
    const siteOf = (l: string): string => /maskingAgreementOf\(snapshots, '([a-z0-9]+)', /.exec(l)?.[1] ?? l;
    const sites = code.filter((l) => l.includes('maskingAgreementOf(') && !l.startsWith('async function ')).map(siteOf);
    b2t1Expect(sites.filter((s) => !['arms', 'judge', 'step0b', 'fidelity'].includes(s)), 'every call passes its admitted snapshots and a literal site').toEqual([]);
    for (const s of ['arms', 'judge', 'step0b']) b2t1Expect(sites.filter((x) => x === s), `one ${s} call`).toHaveLength(1);
    b2t1Expect(code.filter((l) => l.startsWith('const snapshots = maskingSnapshotsOf(')), 'one admission per call').toHaveLength(sites.length);
    b2t1Expect(code.filter((l) => l.includes('refreshPairIndex(')), 'no refresh outside the admission')
      .toEqual(['function refreshPairIndex(rs, home) {', 'function maskingSnapshotsOf(rs, home) { refreshPairIndex(rs, home); return rs.maskingSnapshots.snapshots; }']);
    // CONTROL: the site needle reads a planted literal call, and answers a call with a computed site whole, so it is caught.
    b2t1Expect(siteOf("return maskingAgreementOf(snapshots, 'step0b', async (idx) => {")).toBe('step0b');
    b2t1Expect(siteOf('const x = await maskingAgreementOf(snapshots, who, build, agree);')).toBe('const x = await maskingAgreementOf(snapshots, who, build, agree);');
  });
});

// The subcommand describe spawns the step 0b stub; it skips on darwin, as W2-5b1 Task 4's stub describes do (this task's
// own choice; the pure describe above runs everywhere).
b2t1Describe.skipIf(process.platform === 'darwin')('W2-5b2 Task 1: step0b --section pilot on the stub (W2-D57, W2-D58, W2-D56, W2-D78, W2-D24; Q11, Q23, Q25, Q26, Q31)', () => {
  // W2-5b1 Task 4's SIGINT cases call main's stop handler directly (onStopSignal), which arms an unref'd STOP_GRACE_MS (5 s)
  // timer that SIGKILLs every group the driver's live-child registry holds when it fires. The file runs those cases a few
  // seconds before this describe, so the timer would fire here and kill a stub run at random (measured: a run killed at
  // 12 ms, in the same case of each of three whole-file runs). Waiting out the grace once, before the first case, leaves no stale timer.
  b2t1BeforeAll(async () => { await pause(5_500); }, 20_000);

  b2t1It('every check passes: the box run, then seven treatment-arm runs through the card on the first usage question, each batch behind its preflight; the result written and its sha printed; exit 0', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home);
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted');
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv());
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal, r.stderr).toBeNull();
    b2t1Expect(r.code).toBe(0);
    b2t1Expect(r.stdout).toBe('');
    const text = readFileSync(join(fx.out, 'pilot', 'step0b', 'restricted.json'), 'utf8');
    b2t1Expect(r.stderr).toBe(`sha256 ${sha256Hex(text) as string}\n`);
    const q = fx.q as B2t1R;
    b2t1Expect((fx.entries as B2t1R[]).filter((e) => e.boundary_uuid !== q.boundary_uuid), 'CONTROL: the second question is another boundary').toHaveLength(1);
    const doc = JSON.parse(text) as B2t1R;
    b2t1Expect([doc.kind, doc.v, doc.section, doc.record_sha256, doc.store_id, doc.settings_mode, doc.record_settings_mode, doc.account, doc.model])
      .toEqual([D21.STEP0B_KIND, 1, 'pilot', fx.d.sha, W5B4_STORE_A, 'restricted', 'restricted', 'up-a', W5B4_ARM_MODEL]);
    b2t1Expect(doc.question, 'Q11: the first usage question in qid order').toEqual({ qid: q.qid, ccrc_id: q.ccrc_id, generation: q.generation, boundary_uuid: q.boundary_uuid });
    b2t1Expect([doc.passed, doc.failed, doc.unmeasured]).toEqual([true, [], []]);
    for (const n of D21.STEP0B_CHECKS as string[]) b2t1Expect(doc.checks[n].state, n).toBe('pass');
    b2t1Expect(doc.checks['turn-bound'], 'R1 end to end: 12 main-thread turns beside 2 subagent messages hold')
      .toEqual({ state: 'pass', held: true, turns: 12, num_turns: 12, subtype: 'error_max_turns' });
    b2t1Expect(doc.subagent).toEqual({ state: 'measured', tools: ['Bash'], parents: ['toolu_b2t1_0'], inferred: true });
    const names = ['turn-bound', ...(D21.STEP0B_PROBES as string[])].map((p) => `pilot/step0b/restricted/${p}`);
    b2t1Expect(doc.runs.map((x: B2t1R) => [x.name, x.mode])).toEqual(names.map((n, i) => [n, i === 0 ? 'box' : 'arm']));
    b2t1Expect(doc.runs.map((x: B2t1R) => x.error_fields)).toEqual(names.map(() => []));
    b2t1Expect(doc.runs[0].main_turns).toBe(12);
    b2t1Expect(doc.batches).toEqual([{ claude_code_version: w5b4Version(home), runs: names.slice(0, 1) }, { claude_code_version: w5b4Version(home), runs: names.slice(1) }]);
    b2t1Expect(doc.persistence.map((x: B2t1R) => [x.name, x.left])).toEqual(names.map((n) => [n, false]));
    b2t1Expect(doc.synthetic_transcript).toBe(D21.STEP0B_SYNTHETIC_TRANSCRIPT);
    // the spawns: --version, the box run, --version, then the seven arm runs at concurrency 2 (W2-D56 before each batch)
    const log = (stubLog(home) ?? []) as unknown as B2t1R[];
    b2t1Expect(log.map((e) => (e.argv[0] === '--version' ? 'version' : 'print')).join(' ')).toBe(['version', 'print', 'version', ...Array(7).fill('print')].join(' '));
    const prints = b2t1PrintRuns(home);
    b2t1Expect(prints[0]!.argv).toEqual(D21.spawnArgv({ mode: 'box', model: W5B4_ARM_MODEL, settingsMode: 'restricted', home }));
    b2t1Expect(prints[0]!.stdin).toBe(D21.TURN_PROBE_PROMPT);
    b2t1Expect((prints[0]!.envKeys as string[]).filter((k) => k.startsWith('CCRC_RECALL_')), 'the box run carries no seam value').toEqual([]);
    const arms = prints.slice(1);
    for (const e of arms) {
      b2t1Expect(e.argv).toEqual(D21.spawnArgv({ mode: 'arm', model: W5B4_ARM_MODEL, settingsMode: 'restricted', home }));
      b2t1Expect([e.env.CCRC_RECALL_SESSION, e.env.CCRC_RECALL_ARM, e.env.CCRC_RECALL_ASOF], 'W2-D50: the treatment arm on the first question').toEqual([q.ccrc_id, W5B4_TREATMENT, q.boundary_uuid]);
      b2t1Expect((e.stdin as string).startsWith(`${B2T1_CARD}\n\n`), 'driven through the card (W2-D58)').toBe(true);
    }
    b2t1Expect(arms.map((e) => e.stdin as string).sort()).toEqual(b2t1Probes(home).map(b2t1Stdin).sort());
  }, 60_000);

  b2t1It('a skill missing under --restricted is recorded and halts with pilot-failed; the re-run under --settings-mode fallback runs beside it on the same --out and passes (Q26, Q10)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home);
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted', Object.fromEntries(b2t1Probes(home).map((p) => [p.probe as string, b2t1PassStream(p, { skills: [] })])));
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv());
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal).toEqual({ word: 'pilot-failed',
      detail: 'step0b restricted: failed skill; unmeasured -; the skill is not listed under restricted: re-run step0b with --settings-mode fallback (Q26)' });
    const restricted = join(fx.out, 'pilot', 'step0b', 'restricted.json');
    const text = readFileSync(restricted, 'utf8');
    b2t1Expect(r.stderr, 'recorded before the halt: its sha is printed').toBe(`sha256 ${sha256Hex(text) as string}\n`);
    const doc = JSON.parse(text) as B2t1R;
    b2t1Expect([doc.passed, doc.failed, doc.unmeasured, doc.checks.skill.state]).toEqual([false, ['skill'], [], 'fail']);
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'fallback');
    const r2 = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv(['--settings-mode', 'fallback']));
    b2t1Expect(r2.refusal, r2.stderr).toBeNull();
    b2t1Expect(r2.code).toBe(0);
    const doc2 = b2t1Result(fx.out, 'fallback');
    b2t1Expect([doc2.passed, doc2.settings_mode, doc2.record_settings_mode]).toEqual([true, 'fallback', 'restricted']);
    b2t1Expect(doc2.runs.every((x: B2t1R) => (x.name as string).startsWith('pilot/step0b/fallback/'))).toBe(true);
    b2t1Expect(readFileSync(restricted, 'utf8'), 'the restricted result stands beside it, never folded').toBe(text);
    const fb = b2t1PrintRuns(home).slice(8);
    b2t1Expect(fb).toHaveLength(8);
    for (const e of fb) b2t1Expect(e.argv.slice(0, 4)).toEqual(['--setting-sources', 'project,local', '--settings', '{"disableAllHooks":true}']);
  }, 60_000);

  b2t1It('a denial probe the arm ran, a run with no result event and an Agent call with no subagent tool use: failed and unmeasured apart, the subagent unmeasured with no check of its own, and every error field recorded (Q10, Q11, Q31)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home);
    const by = (n: string): B2t1R => b2t1Probes(home).find((p) => p.probe === n)!;
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted', {
      'deny-chain': b2t1Stream({ calls: [{ command: by('deny-chain').command }] }),
      'spelling-2': b2t1Stream({ calls: [{ command: by('spelling-2').command }], result: false, error: 'fixture_error_a' }),
      agent: b2t1Stream({ calls: [{ name: 'Agent' }], error: 'fixture_error_b' }),
    });
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv());
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal).toEqual({ word: 'pilot-failed', detail: 'step0b restricted: failed deny-chain; unmeasured spelling-2' });
    const doc = b2t1Result(fx.out);
    b2t1Expect(doc.checks['deny-chain']).toEqual({ state: 'fail', denied: false, ran: true, tool_error: false, result_seen: true });
    b2t1Expect(doc.checks['spelling-2'].state).toBe('unmeasured');
    b2t1Expect(doc.subagent).toEqual({ state: 'unmeasured', why: 'no-subagent-tool-use', tools: [], parents: [], inferred: true });
    const errs = Object.fromEntries(doc.runs.map((x: B2t1R) => [x.name, x.error_fields]));
    b2t1Expect(errs['pilot/step0b/restricted/spelling-2']).toEqual(['fixture_error_a']);
    b2t1Expect(errs['pilot/step0b/restricted/agent']).toEqual(['fixture_error_b']);
    b2t1Expect(errs['pilot/step0b/restricted/spelling-1'], 'CONTROL: a run with no error field').toEqual([]);
  }, 60_000);

  b2t1It('a turn-bound run that stops within the bound under another subtype is unmeasured, never held, and the refusal names the subtype (W2-D57, C16)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home);
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted', { 'turn-bound': b2t1Stream({ main: 12, subtype: 'error_turn_limit', session: 'fixture-0b-turn-bound' }) });
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv());
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal).toEqual({ word: 'pilot-failed',
      detail: 'step0b restricted: failed -; unmeasured turn-bound; turn-bound subtype "error_turn_limit": a spelling other than error_max_turns is a coordinator ruling (W2-D57)' });
    b2t1Expect(b2t1Result(fx.out).checks['turn-bound']).toEqual({ state: 'unmeasured', held: 'unmeasured', turns: 12, num_turns: 12, subtype: 'error_turn_limit' });
  }, 60_000);

  b2t1It('a run that leaves its transcript fails persistence; an unreadable projects directory is unmeasured, never clean and never an exit 1 (W2-D57; D-6309\'s rule)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home);
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted');
    const rg = b2t1Probes(home).find((p) => p.probe === 'deny-rg')!;
    b2t1Put(home, 'restricted', b2t1Stdin(rg), '.persist', '');
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv());
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal).toEqual({ word: 'pilot-failed', detail: 'step0b restricted: failed persistence; unmeasured -' });
    const left = (b2t1Result(fx.out).persistence as B2t1R[]).filter((x) => x.left);
    b2t1Expect(left.map((x) => [x.name, x.transcripts.length, x.project_dir])).toEqual([['pilot/step0b/restricted/deny-rg', 1, true]]);
    if ((process.getuid?.() ?? 1) === 0) return;   // mode 000 binds no root
    const home2 = b2t1Home();
    const fx2 = b2t1Pilot(home2);
    b2t1PlantAll(home2, 'restricted');
    const projects = join(home2, '.claude', 'projects');
    mkdirSync(projects, { recursive: true });
    chmodSync(projects, 0o000);
    try {
      const r2 = await b2t1Run(home2, fx2.argv());
      b2t1Expect(r2.refusal).toEqual({ word: 'pilot-failed', detail: 'step0b restricted: failed -; unmeasured persistence' });
      b2t1Expect((b2t1Result(fx2.out).persistence as B2t1R[]).every((x) => x.unmeasured === 'EACCES' && x.left === true)).toBe(true);
    } finally {
      chmodSync(projects, 0o700);
    }
  }, 120_000);

  b2t1It('the record\'s batch_max splits the seven arm runs, and W2-D56\'s --version and W2-D78\'s checks come before every batch (W2-D56, W2-D78)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home, { over: { limits: { batch_max: 4 } } });
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted');
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv());
    b2t1Expect(r.code, r.stderr).toBe(0);
    b2t1Expect(b2t1Versions(home), 'one --version per batch: the box batch and two arm batches').toBe(3);
    b2t1Expect(b2t1Result(fx.out).batches.map((b: B2t1R) => b.runs.length)).toEqual([1, 4, 3]);
    // headless-on removed by the box run: the arm batch refuses before its --version spawn, and no result is written
    const home2 = b2t1Home();
    const fx2 = b2t1Pilot(home2);
    b2t1PlantAll(home2, 'restricted');
    b2t1Put(home2, 'restricted', D21.TURN_PROBE_PROMPT as string, '.rm', b2t1Lib.historyPaths(home2).headlessOn as string);
    const r2 = await b2t1Run(home2, fx2.argv());
    b2t1Expect(r2.refusal?.word).toBe('family-unlisted');
    b2t1Expect([b2t1Versions(home2), b2t1PrintRuns(home2).length], 'the box batch ran; the arm batch spawned nothing').toEqual([1, 1]);
    b2t1Expect(existsSync(join(fx2.out, 'pilot', 'step0b', 'restricted.json')), 'a refusal mid-way writes no result').toBe(false);
  }, 120_000);

  // K26, K28 (D-6481 carried): every card preflight builds the re-check and the card under every retained reading of the
  // pair index (W2-5b1's maskingSnapshotsOf) and refuses when their card lines disagree, never masking with the newest
  // reading. The injected payload reader masks B2T1_LEARNED_CARD through each reading's own index; the store learns the
  // value right after one build, so the next preflight's admission holds the old reading and the new one.
  b2t1It('K26 card seam: a pair learned after the before-out card preflight makes the arm batch\'s two readings disagree, refused input-invalid masking-snapshots-disagree step0b before the arm batch\'s --version, never the newest mask (K28, D-6481 carried)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home);
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted', {}, B2T1_LEARNED_CARD);
    const seen: boolean[] = [];
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv(), { payloads: b2t1IndexPayloads(home, 1, seen) });
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal).toEqual({ word: 'input-invalid', detail: 'masking-snapshots-disagree step0b' });
    b2t1Expect(seen, 'before --out: one reading; the arm batch: the old reading, then the new one').toEqual([false, false, true]);
    b2t1Expect([b2t1Versions(home), b2t1PrintRuns(home).length], 'the box batch ran; the arm batch spawned nothing, not even --version').toEqual([1, 1]);
    b2t1Expect(existsSync(join(fx.out, 'pilot', 'step0b', 'restricted.json')), 'a refusal mid-way writes no result').toBe(false);
  }, 60_000);
  b2t1It('K26 card seam CONTROL: with no pair learned every card preflight holds one reading, the value stays visible on every arm run\'s card, and the pilot passes (K28)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home);
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted', {}, B2T1_LEARNED_CARD);
    const seen: boolean[] = [];
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv(), { payloads: b2t1IndexPayloads(home, null, seen) });
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal, r.stderr).toBeNull();
    b2t1Expect(r.code).toBe(0);
    b2t1Expect(seen, 'one reading at each of the two card preflights, neither masking').toEqual([false, false]);
    const arms = b2t1PrintRuns(home).slice(1);
    b2t1Expect(arms).toHaveLength(7);
    for (const e of arms) b2t1Expect((e.stdin as string).startsWith(`${B2T1_LEARNED_CARD}\n\n`), 'the agreed card drives every arm run').toBe(true);
  }, 60_000);
  b2t1It('K28 later arm batch: a pair learned after the first arm batch\'s card preflight lets its four runs stand and refuses the second arm batch input-invalid masking-snapshots-disagree step0b before its --version (K26, D-6481 carried)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home, { over: { limits: { batch_max: 4 } } });
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted', {}, B2T1_LEARNED_CARD);
    const seen: boolean[] = [];
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv(), { payloads: b2t1IndexPayloads(home, 2, seen) });
    b2t1Expect(r.refusal).toEqual({ word: 'input-invalid', detail: 'masking-snapshots-disagree step0b' });
    b2t1Expect(seen, 'before --out and the first arm batch: one reading each; the second arm batch: old, then new').toEqual([false, false, false, true]);
    b2t1Expect([b2t1Versions(home), b2t1PrintRuns(home).length], 'the box batch and the first arm batch ran; the second spawned nothing').toEqual([2, 5]);
    for (const e of b2t1PrintRuns(home).slice(1)) b2t1Expect((e.stdin as string).startsWith(`${B2T1_LEARNED_CARD}\n\n`), 'the first arm batch ran under the agreed card').toBe(true);
    b2t1Expect(existsSync(join(fx.out, 'pilot', 'step0b', 'restricted.json')), 'a refusal mid-way writes no result').toBe(false);
  }, 120_000);
  b2t1It('K28 later arm batch CONTROL: with no pair learned no card preflight masks the value, both arm batches run, and the pilot passes (K26)', async () => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const fx = b2t1Pilot(home, { over: { limits: { batch_max: 4 } } });
    b2t1PlantAll(home, 'restricted', {}, B2T1_LEARNED_CARD);
    const seen: boolean[] = [];
    const r = await b2t1Run(home, fx.argv(), { payloads: b2t1IndexPayloads(home, null, seen) });
    b2t1Expect(r.code, r.stderr).toBe(0);
    b2t1Expect(seen.length > 0 && seen.every((masked) => !masked), 'no reading masked the value').toBe(true);
    b2t1Expect(b2t1Versions(home), 'one --version per batch').toBe(3);
    b2t1Expect(b2t1Result(fx.out).batches.map((b: B2t1R) => b.runs.length)).toEqual([1, 4, 3]);
  }, 120_000);

  // A matcher is a RegExp, or a function building one at run time: an export read while the describe is collected would
  // throw before Step 5 and fail the whole file, so every row reads D21 inside its own case.
  const BEFORE_OUT: Array<[string, string, RegExp | (() => RegExp), (h: string) => { fx: B2t1R; argv: string[]; deps?: B2t1R }]> = [
    ['Q23: --allow-code-change is not a step0b flag', 'args-invalid', /^--allow-code-change is not a step0b --section pilot flag$/, (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h);
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv(['--allow-code-change']) };
    }],
    // The detail is built from STEP0B_SECTIONS, so the expectation is too: Task 3's 'quiz' widens both alike.
    ['a section outside STEP0B_SECTIONS', 'args-invalid', () => new RegExp(`^step0b wants --section ${(D21.STEP0B_SECTIONS as string[]).join(' or --section ')}, not "usage"$`), (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h);
      return { fx, argv: (fx.argv() as string[]).map((a) => (a === 'pilot' ? 'usage' : a)) };
    }],
    ['a settings mode outside SETTINGS_MODES', 'args-invalid', /^settings-mode open$/, (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h);
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv(['--settings-mode', 'open']) };
    }],
    ['a batch_max that cannot hold both arms (R28 of the W2-5b1 plan)', 'record-invalid', /^limits\.batch_max out-of-range$/, (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h, { over: { limits: { batch_max: 1 } } });
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv() };
    }],
    ['W2-D78 (i): no headless-on', 'family-unlisted', /./, (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h, { marker: false });
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv() };
    }],
    ['W2-D78 (ii): a recall-off entry for the family', 'family-recall-off', /^present pilot-4$/, (h) => {
      const p = b2t1Lib.recallOffPath(h, 'pilot-4') as string;
      mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
      writeFileSync(p, '');
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h);
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv() };
    }],
    ['W2-D78 (iii): the question no longer answers', 'quiz-unanswerable', /^fixture clause \(b\) unanswerable$/, (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h);
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv(), deps: { recheck: async (): Promise<never> => b2t1Drv.refuse('quiz-unanswerable', 'fixture clause (b) unanswerable') } };
    }],
    ['D-6469: the payload no longer reconstructs', 'quiz-unanswerable', / payload card-unrenderable$/, (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h);
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv(), deps: { payloads: (): B2t1R => ({ state: 'discard', why: 'card-unrenderable' }) } };
    }],
    ['Q11: the synthetic transcript path exists', 'input-invalid', /^synthetic transcript .+ exists$/, (h) => {
      const fx = b2t1Pilot(h);
      return { fx, argv: fx.argv(), deps: { syntheticTranscript: fx.d.path } };
    }],
  ];
  b2t1It.each(BEFORE_OUT)('W2-5b2 Task 1 refuses before --out, with the stub log absent: %s', async (_label, word, detail, setup) => {
    const home = b2t1Home();
    const { fx, argv, deps } = setup(home);
```

```js
/** W2-5b2 Task 1: persistenceLeft as step 0b records it, `{left, transcripts, project_dir}`. An lstat or readdir failure
 *  under projects/ (an errno, which persistenceLeft throws so it never reads as clean) is answered as left, with the errno
 *  named as `unmeasured`: the run is recorded and fails closed after --out, never an exit 1 (D-6309's rule). Any other
 *  throw (a TypeError for a bad argument) is a defect and stays one.
 *  @param {{ configDir: string, sessionId: string | null, cwd: string }} o */
export function persistenceMeasured(o) {
  let l;
  try {
    l = persistenceLeft(o);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof TypeError || typeof e?.code !== 'string') throw e;
    return { left: true, transcripts: [], project_dir: null, unmeasured: e.code };
  }
  return { left: l.left, transcripts: l.transcripts, project_dir: l.projectDir };
}
```

```js
/** K28 (W2-5b2 Task 1; D-6481 carried, K26): the one all-readings-agree loop, factored out of W2-5b1's armBatchPreflight
 *  and judgeCommand without a change of behaviour, and called by step 0b's card preflight and fidelity's per-boundary
 *  measurement too. `snapshots` is what maskingSnapshotsOf(rs, home) answered in the caller's same preflight, so its
 *  admission refusals (belt overflow, count cap, material cap, invalid, refresh failed) come before any build; this
 *  function never refreshes, reads the store, writes or spawns. `build(idx)` builds the caller's spawned text from one
 *  retained reading's pair index (it may be async; its own refusals and throws pass through unchanged); `agree(first,
 *  built)` compares a later reading's build with the first's through sameMaskingText. Readings are built in retained
 *  order, each compared as soon as it is built; the first disagreement refuses input-invalid
 *  `masking-snapshots-disagree <site>`, `site` one of the literal words arms, judge, step0b and fidelity, so the detail
 *  names a site and never a value. Answers the first reading's build: agreeing readings are byte-equal, and no
 *  newest-reading mask is ever chosen.
 *  @param {Array<{ idx: unknown }>} snapshots  @param {string} site  @param {(idx: any) => any} build
 *  @param {(first: any, built: any) => boolean} agree  @returns {Promise<any>} */
async function maskingAgreementOf(snapshots, site, build, agree) {
  let agreed;
  for (let i = 0; i < snapshots.length; i += 1) {
    const built = await build(snapshots[i].idx);
    if (i === 0) agreed = built;
    else if (!agree(agreed, built)) refuse('input-invalid', `masking-snapshots-disagree ${site}`);
  }
  return agreed;
}
```

```js
// ── W2-5b2 Task 1: step 0b, `step0b --section pilot` (W2-D57, W2-D58; Q10, Q11, Q23, Q25, Q26, Q31; R1) ──────────────
// The pilot's first act after part 1 (W2 decisions §5, act 14), on the pilot node, in the pilot's fresh --out (Q25), with
// headless-on listing the pilot pairs (act 13). Two kinds of batch, each behind W2-D56's preflight (W2-5b1's preflightSpawn):
//   - the box batch: W2-4's step0bMechanics, one box-mode run of TURN_PROBE_PROMPT: the turn bound over the run's
//     main-thread turns (R1) and the persistence check (W2-D57);
//   - the arm batches, at most limits.batch_max runs each: one treatment-arm run per STEP0B_PROBES member on the first
//     usage question in qid order (Q11), each stdin the question's card line, one blank line, then the probe's prompt,
//     so the treatment arm is driven through the card and the shipped skill (W2-D58): each taught spelling once
//     (admitted), three denial probes over a synthetic transcript path that does not exist (Q11), and one Agent call,
//     whose subagent's tool_use names, read through parentToolUseId, are recorded as its tool list, labelled inferred.
//     Every arm run's init event must show exactly the tools its argv grants, no MCP server, no plugin, and the
//     ccrc-history skill (W2-D57, W2-D58). W2-D78 (i), (ii) and (iii) and the card are asked before --out and before
//     every arm batch (W2-5b1's requireListed, refuseRecallOff, recheckBatch and armPayloads; D-6469), each time under
//     every retained reading of the store's pair index (W2-5b1's maskingSnapshotsOf), whose card lines must agree
//     (maskingAgreementOf, K28) or the preflight refuses masking-snapshots-disagree step0b, never the newest mask (K26).
// Each check is pass, fail or unmeasured, never folded (W2-D84's rule for an unmeasured value); a pilot passes only when
// every check passes (Q10, fail-closed). The result is written under --out whatever it shows and `sha256 <hex>` printed
// on stderr (D-5983); a pilot that did not pass then refuses `pilot-failed`, naming the failed and the unmeasured checks
// apart (W2-D57: a failure halts W2 for an operator ruling). A skill missing under --restricted is one such failure: the
// operator re-runs with --settings-mode fallback (Q26), whose runs and result live beside the restricted ones, never over
// them. Every error field each run's events carried is recorded (Q31). No --allow-code-change (Q23). The arm words are
// never spelled here: the arm is TREATMENT_ARM (W2-D42).

/** The sections step 0b runs for. This task ships the pilot's; the mid-window re-pilot on a listed quiz family (Q12) is
 *  a later W2-5b2 task's, which adds its section here. */
export const STEP0B_SECTIONS = Object.freeze(['pilot']);
/** The kind word of `<section>/step0b/<settings mode>.json`. */
export const STEP0B_KIND = 'ccrc-history-w2-step0b';
/** The treatment-arm runs, in order (W2-D58; Q11): each taught spelling once, the three denial probes, the Agent call. */
export const STEP0B_PROBES = Object.freeze(['spelling-1', 'spelling-2', 'spelling-3', 'deny-chain', 'deny-subst', 'deny-rg', 'agent']);
/** The checks a pilot must pass, every one of them (Q10, fail-closed), in the order a result lists them. */
export const STEP0B_CHECKS = Object.freeze(['turn-bound', 'persistence', 'tools', 'mcp', 'plugins', 'skill',
  'spelling-1', 'spelling-2', 'spelling-3', 'deny-chain', 'deny-subst', 'deny-rg']);
/** A check's state: driver-local report words (S2's C21), never refusals; unmeasured is never folded into the other two. */
export const STEP0B_STATES = Object.freeze(['pass', 'fail', 'unmeasured']);
/** The skill every treatment-arm run's init event must list (W2-D58), as ccd/history-skill/SKILL.md names it. */
export const HISTORY_SKILL = 'ccrc-history';
/** Q11: the transcript path the denial probes name. It must not exist, which step0b measures before --out. */
export const STEP0B_SYNTHETIC_TRANSCRIPT = '/nonexistent/ccrc-step0b/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b0.jsonl';
const STEP0B_RUNS = Object.freeze(['turn-bound', ...STEP0B_PROBES]);

function step0bNameOk(who, section, settingsMode) {
  if (!STEP0B_SECTIONS.includes(section)) throw new TypeError(`${who}: section ${JSON.stringify(section)} is not one of ${STEP0B_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`);
  if (!SETTINGS_MODES.includes(settingsMode)) throw new TypeError(`${who}: settings mode ${JSON.stringify(settingsMode)} is not one of ${SETTINGS_MODES.join(', ')}`);
}
/** One step 0b run's name under --out: its section, its settings mode (Q26: a fallback re-run on the same --out never
 *  meets a restricted run, which W2-4's finishedOutcome would refuse as run-json-mismatch) and the run. Pure.
 *  @param {string} section  @param {string} settingsMode  @param {string} run  @returns {string} */
export function step0bRunName(section, settingsMode, run) {
  step0bNameOk('step0bRunName', section, settingsMode);
  if (!STEP0B_RUNS.includes(run)) throw new TypeError(`step0bRunName: ${JSON.stringify(run)} is not a step 0b run`);
  return `${section}/step0b/${settingsMode}/${run}`;
}
/** The result's path under --out, one per section and settings mode, so a re-run under fallback writes beside the
 *  restricted result, never over it (Q26). Pure.  @param {string} section  @param {string} settingsMode  @returns {string} */
export function step0bRel(section, settingsMode) {
  step0bNameOk('step0bRel', section, settingsMode);
  return `${section}/step0b/${settingsMode}.json`;
}

// ── pure ──
/** One check over several runs: a measured fail on any run fails it; otherwise an unmeasured run, or no run at all,
 *  leaves it unmeasured; otherwise it passes. Each run's own reading stays in the result. Pure. */
function foldStates(states) {
  if (states.includes('fail')) return 'fail';
  if (states.length === 0 || states.includes('unmeasured')) return 'unmeasured';
  return 'pass';
}
/** W2-D57's turn bound as a check: turnBoundHeld's `held`, true a pass, false a fail, 'unmeasured' unmeasured (C16: any
 *  subtype but MAX_TURNS_STOP_SUBTYPE is the coordinator's ruling, never held). Pure. */
export function turnBoundCheckOf(tb) {
  const state = tb.held === true ? 'pass' : tb.held === false ? 'fail' : 'unmeasured';
  return { state, held: tb.held, turns: tb.turns, num_turns: tb.num_turns, subtype: tb.subtype };
}
/** W2-D57's persistence check over every step 0b run: one that left a transcript or a project dir fails it; one whose
 *  check could not be measured (persistenceMeasured's `unmeasured`) leaves it unmeasured. Pure. */
export function persistenceCheckOf(runs) {
  return { state: foldStates(runs.map((p) => (p.unmeasured !== undefined ? 'unmeasured' : p.left ? 'fail' : 'pass'))) };
}
/** A taught spelling's run (W2-D58), from W2-4's probeFindingOf: admitted when the stream's result event carries
 *  permission_denials (result_seen), the call was made (ran) and no denial names it. A denial fails it; no result event,
 *  or no call made, is unmeasured: the run showed nothing about admission. tool_error is recorded and decides nothing. Pure. */
export function admissionCheckOf(f) {
  const state = !f.result_seen ? 'unmeasured' : f.denied ? 'fail' : f.ran ? 'pass' : 'unmeasured';
  return { state, denied: f.denied, ran: f.ran, tool_error: f.tool_error, result_seen: f.result_seen };
}
/** A denial probe's run (W2-D58): a denial naming its call passes; a call that ran with no denial is a fail (print mode
 *  admitted it); no result event, or no call made, is unmeasured. Pure. */
export function denialCheckOf(f) {
  const state = !f.result_seen ? 'unmeasured' : f.denied ? 'pass' : f.ran ? 'fail' : 'unmeasured';
  return { state, denied: f.denied, ran: f.ran, tool_error: f.tool_error, result_seen: f.result_seen };
}
const skillNamed = (s) => s === HISTORY_SKILL || (plainObject(s) && s.name === HISTORY_SKILL);
const sameSet = (got, want) => got.length === want.length && [...got].sort().join('\n') === [...want].sort().join('\n');
/** W2-D57's "the arm's init event" and W2-D58's init assertions, one check each over every arm run's init event: tools
 *  exactly `want` (the arm argv's, armToolsOf), no MCP server, no plugin, the ccrc-history skill listed (a string, or an
 *  object with that name). A run with no init event, or a field that is not a list, leaves that check unmeasured on that
 *  run (foldStates). Pure.
 *  @param {Array<StreamInit | null>} inits  @param {readonly string[]} want */
export function initChecksOf(inits, want) {
  const over = (read) => ({ state: foldStates(inits.map((i) => (i === null ? 'unmeasured' : read(i)))) });
  return {
    tools: over((i) => (i.tools === null ? 'unmeasured' : sameSet(i.tools, want) ? 'pass' : 'fail')),
    mcp: over((i) => (i.mcpServers === null ? 'unmeasured' : i.mcpServers.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail')),
    plugins: over((i) => (i.plugins === null ? 'unmeasured' : i.plugins.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail')),
    skill: over((i) => (i.skills === null ? 'unmeasured' : i.skills.some(skillNamed) ? 'pass' : 'fail')),
  };
}
/** Q11: an Agent subagent's tool list, as its observed tool_use names: every tool pair whose parentToolUseId is set
 *  (W2-5b1 Task 1), names sorted and unique, labelled inferred (no event lists a subagent's tools). A subagent that made no
 *  tool call leaves it unmeasured. Recorded only: Q10's list fails no pilot on it. Pure. */
export function subagentToolsOf(toolPairs) {
  const child = toolPairs.filter((p) => typeof p.parentToolUseId === 'string');
  const parents = [...new Set(child.map((p) => p.parentToolUseId))].sort();
  if (child.length === 0) return { state: 'unmeasured', why: 'no-subagent-tool-use', tools: [], parents, inferred: true };
  return { state: 'measured', tools: [...new Set(child.map((p) => p.name))].sort(), parents, inferred: true };
}
/** Q10, fail-closed: the pilot passes only when every check passes; the failed and the unmeasured are listed apart, in
 *  STEP0B_CHECKS order, never folded. A missing check, or a state outside STEP0B_STATES, is a defect. Pure. */
export function step0bVerdictOf(checks) {
  for (const name of STEP0B_CHECKS) {
    if (!plainObject(checks?.[name]) || !STEP0B_STATES.includes(checks[name].state)) {
      throw new TypeError(`step0bVerdictOf: check ${name} has no state of ${STEP0B_STATES.join(', ')}`);
    }
  }
  const failed = STEP0B_CHECKS.filter((n) => checks[n].state === 'fail');
  const unmeasured = STEP0B_CHECKS.filter((n) => checks[n].state === 'unmeasured');
  return { passed: failed.length === 0 && unmeasured.length === 0, failed, unmeasured };
}
/** The `pilot-failed` detail: the settings mode, the failed and the unmeasured checks apart; the turn-bound subtype read
 *  when that check is unmeasured (C16: another spelling is the coordinator's ruling); and, when the skill is missing under
 *  restricted, the re-run Q26 names. Pure. */
export function step0bFailureDetail(settingsMode, checks, verdict) {
  const parts = [`step0b ${settingsMode}: failed ${verdict.failed.join(' ') || '-'}; unmeasured ${verdict.unmeasured.join(' ') || '-'}`];
  const tb = checks['turn-bound'];
  if (tb.state === 'unmeasured') parts.push(`turn-bound subtype ${JSON.stringify(tb.subtype)}: a spelling other than ${MAX_TURNS_STOP_SUBTYPE} is a coordinator ruling (W2-D57)`);
  if (settingsMode === 'restricted' && checks.skill.state === 'fail') parts.push('the skill is not listed under restricted: re-run step0b with --settings-mode fallback (Q26)');
  return parts.join('; ');
}
/** The tools a spawn's argv grants (`--tools <list>`), sorted: the set every arm run's init must show exactly. Pure. */
export function armToolsOf(argv) {
  const i = argv.indexOf('--tools');
  if (i < 0 || typeof argv[i + 1] !== 'string') throw new TypeError('armToolsOf: the argv carries no --tools value');
  return argv[i + 1].split(',').filter((t) => t !== '').sort();
}
/** The treatment-arm runs' commands (W2-D58; Q11), in STEP0B_PROBES order: each taught spelling's `history status
 *  --json` (W2-4's probeCommandOf); then three print mode must deny, each naming `transcript`, a path that does not exist:
 *  the card's command chained to a `cat`, the card's command with a `$(…)` substitution, and an `rg`; then the Agent call,
 *  whose subagent is asked to run the card's command. Pure.  @param {string} home  @param {string} transcript */
export function step0bProbesOf(home, transcript) {
  if (typeof transcript !== 'string' || !path.isAbsolute(transcript)) throw new TypeError(`step0bProbesOf: transcript ${JSON.stringify(transcript)} is not absolute`);
  const taught = allowedToolSpellings(home).map(probeCommandOf);
  const card = taught[2];   // the card's spelling (spec §8.6), the one the denial probes extend
  return Object.freeze([
    ...taught.map((command, i) => ({ probe: STEP0B_PROBES[i], expect: 'admitted', command })),
    { probe: 'deny-chain', expect: 'denied', command: `${card}; cat ${transcript}` },
    { probe: 'deny-subst', expect: 'denied', command: `${card} "$(cat ${transcript})"` },
    { probe: 'deny-rg', expect: 'denied', command: `rg -n . ${transcript}` },
    { probe: 'agent', expect: 'subagent', command: card },
  ].map((p) => Object.freeze(p)));
}
/** The Agent probe's prompt: one Agent call whose subagent runs exactly `command` once. */
function agentPromptOf(command) {
  return [
    'This is a subagent check. Use the Agent tool exactly once, and make no other tool call yourself.',
    'Ask the subagent to use its Bash tool exactly once, to run exactly this command, with nothing added before or after it:',
    '',
    command,
    '',
    'After the subagent returns, reply with the single word DONE.',
  ].join('\n') + '\n';
}
/** One treatment-arm run's stdin: the card line, one blank line, then the probe's prompt (W2-5b1 Task 2's prependCard,
 *  the treatment payload's shape, Q20). Pure.  @param {string} cardLine  @param {{expect: string, command: string}} p */
export function step0bStdinOf(cardLine, p) {
  if (typeof cardLine !== 'string' || cardLine === '' || cardLine.includes('\n')) throw new TypeError('step0bStdinOf: the card line is one non-empty line');
  return prependCard(cardLine, p.expect === 'subagent' ? agentPromptOf(p.command) : probePromptOf(p.command));
}

// ── measuring and acting ──
/** Q11: the synthetic transcript path does not exist, measured before --out. A path that exists, or one whose lstat
 *  fails for another reason, refuses input-invalid: the denial probes would name a real file. */
function refuseSyntheticPresent(p) {
  try {
    lstatSync(p);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e?.code === 'ENOENT' || e?.code === 'ENOTDIR') return;
    refuse('input-invalid', `synthetic transcript ${p} unmeasured ${errCode(e)}`);
  }
  refuse('input-invalid', `synthetic transcript ${p} exists`);
}
/** W2-D78 (i), (ii) and (iii) for step 0b's one question, then its card line, through W2-5b1's requireListed,
 *  refuseRecallOff, recheckBatch (over the roster's config dirs) and armPayloads; a payload that no longer reconstructs
 *  refuses quiz-unanswerable `<qid> payload <word>` (D-6469). K26, K28 (D-6481 carried): the store's retained readings are
 *  admitted first (W2-5b1's maskingSnapshotsOf), and the re-check and the card are built under every one of them; their
 *  card lines must agree (maskingAgreementOf, site step0b), or the preflight refuses input-invalid
 *  `masking-snapshots-disagree step0b` before any spawn or persistence, never masking with the newest reading. Answers
 *  the agreed card line. Called before --out and before every arm batch, for the pilot and the quiz section alike. */
async function step0bCardOf(ctx) {
  const snapshots = maskingSnapshotsOf(ctx.rs, ctx.home);
  requireListed(ctx.home, ctx.storeId, familiesOf([ctx.q]));   // W2-D78 (i)
  refuseRecallOff(ctx.home, [ctx.q.ccrc_id]);   // W2-D78 (ii)
  return maskingAgreementOf(snapshots, 'step0b', async (idx) => {
    const view = { ...ctx.rs, idx };
    const v = (await ctx.deps.recheck(view, [ctx.q], { configDirs: ctx.configDirs })).get(ctx.q.qid);   // W2-D78 (iii), under every retained reading
    const p = ctx.deps.payloads(view, v.boundaryEntryId, ctx.q.question, v.cut);
    if (p.state !== 'payloads') refuse('quiz-unanswerable', `${ctx.q.qid} payload ${p.why}`);   // D-6469
    return p.card.line;
  }, sameMaskingText);
}
/** One run as the result records it: its outcome's code, signal and charge, its init session, its result subtype, its
 *  main-thread and total messages (R1), and every error field its events carried (Q31; W2-5b1 Task 4's errorFieldsOf). */
function step0bRunOf(mode, o) {
  const read = readPlain(o.streamPath, OUT_STREAM_CAP);
  if (read.state !== 'bytes') refuse('out-refused', `run-stream-changed ${o.name}`);
  const f = o.facts;
  return {
    name: o.name, mode, code: o.code, signal: o.signal ?? null, tokens: o.tokens,
    session_id: f.init === null ? null : f.init.sessionId,
    subtype: f.result === null ? null : f.result.subtype, is_error: f.result === null ? null : f.result.isError,
    main_turns: mainThreadTurns(f), messages: f.messages.length,
    error_fields: errorFieldsOf(streamEventsOf(read.bytes.toString('utf8'))),
  };
}

/** Q25's refusal, one spelling (W2-D12, K4): a pilot act runs on a fresh --out, never on pilot-source's, so an --out that
 *  holds PILOT_SOURCE_FILE refuses out-refused, naming the act. step0b calls it here; W2-5b2 Task 2 routes arms through it
 *  and calls it from fidelity and pilot-result, and Task 3 from the re-pilot's forms.
 *  @param {string} out  @param {string} who */
function refusePilotSourceOut(out, who) {
  if (lstatOrNull(out, PILOT_SOURCE_FILE) !== null) refuse('out-refused', `${PILOT_SOURCE_FILE} is here: ${who} on a fresh --out, never pilot-source's`);
}

// A handler that takes deps after its env names that parameter driverEnv, never env (W2-4 Task 5's env scan).
/** `step0b --section pilot` (W2 decisions §5 act 14; W2-D57, W2-D58). In order: the section and its form's flags (no
 *  --allow-code-change, Q23), the asked settings mode; HOME; W2-5b1's loadArmRun (part 1, its gate_code re-checked first,
 *  W2-D24; the pilot frozen list against part 1; part 1's settings mode); the unusable inputs; the store, once, and
 *  armNodeOf (this node named, its questions in qid order, part 1's pilot_budget, W2-D56's expected); the ranges with the
 *  batch shape and refuseSpawnAdmission; W2-D78 (i) to (iii) and the card for the first question; the synthetic path
 *  absent (Q11); all before prepareOut (W2-5a's R10). Then --out (fresh of pilot-source's output, Q25), the claim, the
 *  account, the gate, the box batch and the arm batches, each behind preflightSpawn. The result is written whatever it
 *  shows and its sha printed on stderr, stdout empty (D-5983); exit 0 when the pilot passed, else `pilot-failed` (exit 2). */
export async function step0bCommand(flags, driverEnv, deps = { recheck: recheckBatch, payloads: armPayloads, now: () => Date.now() }) {
  const section = flags.section;
  if (!STEP0B_SECTIONS.includes(section)) refuse('args-invalid', `step0b wants --section ${STEP0B_SECTIONS.join(' or --section ')}, not ${JSON.stringify(section ?? null)}`);
  checkFlags(`step0b --section ${section}`, flags);
  const asked = flags['settings-mode'];
  if (asked !== undefined && !SETTINGS_MODES.includes(asked)) refuse('args-invalid', `settings-mode ${asked}`);
  const home = subcommandHome(driverEnv);
  const run = loadArmRun(flags, section, { nowMs: deps.now() });   // W2-D24 (step0b): gate_code before any other input
  const record = run.record;
  const settingsMode = asked ?? run.settingsMode;   // Q26: part 1's mode, or the fallback the operator re-runs with
  const transcript = deps.syntheticTranscript ?? STEP0B_SYNTHETIC_TRANSCRIPT;
  refuseUnusableInputs(home, flags.out, [['arm-model', record.arm_model]]);
  const rs = openReplayStore(home);
  try {
    const storeId = rs.storeId;
    const node = armNodeOf(run, storeId);
    const q = node.questions[0];   // Q11: the first usage question in qid order (a frozen list is sorted by qid)
    refuseOutOfRangeValues({ budget: node.budget, budgetField: section === 'pilot' ? 'pilot_budget' : 'spend_budget', limits: node.limits, quotas: null, batch: true });
    refuseSpawnAdmission({ home, accountId: node.account, limits: node.limits, expected: node.expected });   // step0b: W2-5a's R10
    const ctx = { home, rs, storeId, q, deps, configDirs: rosterConfigDirs(readRoster(home).roster, home) };
    await step0bCardOf(ctx);   // W2-D78 (i) to (iii) and the card before --out; asked again before every arm batch
    refuseSyntheticPresent(transcript);   // Q11
    const out = prepareOut(flags.out);
    refuseColonInRealOut(out);
    refusePilotSourceOut(out, 'step0b runs');
    const claim = claimOut(out);
    try {
      const { json, roster } = readRoster(home);
      const launch = admitAccount(json, roster, node.account, home);
      const gate = batchGate({ out, home, accountId: launch.accountId, budget: node.budget, limits: node.limits });
      const model = record.arm_model;
      const lang = driverEnv.LANG;
      const nameOf = (r) => step0bRunName(section, settingsMode, r);
      let expected = node.expected;   // W2-D56's values for every batch; the re-pilot replaces the version (W2-5b2 Task 3)
      const spawnPre = () => preflightSpawn({ launch, home, out, lang, gate, expected });
      const batches = [];
      // The box batch: W2-D56, then W2-4's mechanics under this mode's name (R1's main-thread turns; persistence).
      const pre0 = await spawnPre();
      const mech = await step0bMechanics({ launch, out, model, settingsMode, lang, gate, claim, name: nameOf('turn-bound') });
      batches.push({ claude_code_version: pre0.version, runs: [nameOf('turn-bound')] });
      const box = finishedOutcome({ launch, mode: 'box', model, settingsMode, out, name: nameOf('turn-bound') });
      // The arm batches: W2-D78 and the card, then W2-D56, before each; at most limits.batch_max runs at limits.concurrency.
      const probes = step0bProbesOf(home, transcript);
      const outcomes = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < probes.length; i += node.limits.batch_max) {
        const cardLine = await step0bCardOf(ctx);
        const pre = await spawnPre();
        const jobs = probes.slice(i, i + node.limits.batch_max).map((p) => {
          const job = { launch, mode: 'arm', model, settingsMode, recall: { session: q.ccrc_id, arm: TREATMENT_ARM, asof: q.boundary_uuid },
            stdin: step0bStdinOf(cardLine, p), out, name: nameOf(p.probe), lang };
          return deps.timeoutMs === undefined ? job : { ...job, timeoutMs: deps.timeoutMs };
        });
        outcomes.push(...await runBatch(jobs, { gate, claim, concurrency: node.limits.concurrency }));
        batches.push({ claude_code_version: pre.version, runs: jobs.map((j) => j.name) });
      }
      const persistence = [{ name: box.name, ...mech.persistence }, ...outcomes.map((o) => ({ name: o.name,
        ...persistenceMeasured({ configDir: launch.configDir, sessionId: o.facts.init === null ? null : o.facts.init.sessionId, cwd: o.cwd }) }))];
      const checks = {
        'turn-bound': turnBoundCheckOf(mech.turn_bound),
        persistence: persistenceCheckOf(persistence),
        ...initChecksOf(outcomes.map((o) => o.facts.init), armToolsOf(spawnArgv({ mode: 'arm', model, settingsMode, home }))),
        ...Object.fromEntries(probes.flatMap((p, k) => (p.expect === 'subagent' ? [] : [[p.probe,
          (p.expect === 'admitted' ? admissionCheckOf : denialCheckOf)(probeFindingOf(outcomes[k].facts, p.command))]]))),
      };
      const verdict = step0bVerdictOf(checks);
      const agent = outcomes[probes.findIndex((p) => p.expect === 'subagent')];
      const output = {
        kind: STEP0B_KIND, v: 1, section, record_sha256: run.recordSha256, store_id: storeId, measured_ms: Date.now(),
        account: launch.accountId, model, settings_mode: settingsMode, record_settings_mode: run.settingsMode,
        question: { qid: q.qid, ccrc_id: q.ccrc_id, generation: q.generation, boundary_uuid: q.boundary_uuid },
        synthetic_transcript: transcript, batches, checks, subagent: subagentToolsOf(agent.facts.toolPairs), persistence,
        runs: [step0bRunOf('box', box), ...outcomes.map((o) => step0bRunOf('arm', o))],
        passed: verdict.passed, failed: verdict.failed, unmeasured: verdict.unmeasured,
        budget: node.budget, spend: spentSoFar(out),
      };
      const rel = step0bRel(section, settingsMode);
      ensurePlainDir(out, `${section}/step0b`);
      writePlain(out, rel, canonicalJson(output) + '\n');
      process.stderr.write(`sha256 ${shaOfPlain(out, rel)}\n`);   // D-5983: printed whatever the pilot showed
      if (!verdict.passed) refuse('pilot-failed', step0bFailureDetail(settingsMode, checks, verdict));   // W2-D57: halts, recorded
      return EXIT.OK;
    } finally {
      claim.release();
    }
  } finally {
    rs.close();
  }
}

HANDLERS.set('step0b', (flags, env) => step0bCommand(flags, env));
```

### Task 2: fidelity, the usage pilot's result, and open --finalize's derived spend budget (W2-D76, W2-D55, W2-D64, W2-D82; Q6 to Q10, Q25, Q27; K2, K3, K13, K14, K15, K21, K25, K26, K28; D-6280, D-6644, D-6723; review 811's F2 to F5)

This task is the scoping study's Task 7 (scope.md section B). After it, the operator's pilot (W2 decisions §5, act 14) has every subcommand it needs but step 0b (W2-5b2 Task 1's): `fidelity --section pilot` measures the fidelity boundaries, W2-5b1's `arms --section pilot` and `judge --section pilot` run the usage pilot, and `pilot-result --section pilot` writes the file `open --finalize` reads (act 17). It adds two subcommands, `fidelity` and `pilot-result`, each with one section, `pilot` (Task 3 adds the `quiz` sections, K1). It extends W2-5b1's two pilot forms in place for step 0b's settings mode (K2, licensed under K5), edits `open --finalize`, and carries review 811's four range carries from the ledger ("For W2-5b2's plan"):

- **The original side from the store.** `fidelityOriginalOf(rs, boundaryEntryId)` reads boundary N's epoch rows (N's own transcript's rows in N's holding copy, before N, in file order) and N's holding copy's rows, each body read lazily through W2-5a's `entryBodyOf`, and hands them to W2-5a's pure `originalSideOf` (about :4781 at 0de4cc990). A body lost to a tombstone, a cap or a decode is `unmeasured` with its own word, never a 0. `boundaryEntryIdOf(rs, uuid)` resolves pilot-source's `boundary_uuid` to N's entry.
- **Step 0b's settings mode (K2, Q26).** `fidelity --section pilot`, `arms --section pilot` and `judge --section pilot` take an optional `--step0b`/`--step0b-sha256`: step 0b's result (W2-5b2 Task 1's file, `<section>/step0b/<settings mode>.json`), its sha checked before a byte is parsed (`loadInput`). Given, the act runs under that result's `settings_mode`, and the result must be a `step0b --section pilot` result for this part 1 (`input-invalid` otherwise) that passed (`pilot-failed` otherwise). Absent, the act runs under part 1's `settings_mode`, as W2-5b1 ships. One reader, `step0bModeOf`, inside W2-5b1's `loadArmRun` (so `arms` and `judge` share it) and in `fidelity`. So the fallback flow (Q26) is: step 0b again with `--settings-mode fallback`, then every pilot act with `--step0b` naming the passed result (README, Task 6).
- **`fidelity --section pilot` (W2-D76; Q8, Q9, Q25).** Box mode: the arm argv with no seam env, so it needs no marker (Q8). Before `--out`: part 1 and its `gate_code` (W2-D24, first), the ranges (D-6309's rule: the budget, the limits, the batch shape, part 1's settings mode and `pilot.tolerance`), step 0b's result when given (K2), pilot-source's output with its sha, checked against part 1 for seed, frozen sha, families, `n_fidelity` and store (Q9), the store and the node, and W2-5b1 Task 4's `refuseSpawnAdmission`. Then a fresh `--out` that holds no `pilot-source.json` (Q25, Task 1's `refusePilotSourceOut`), and per fidelity boundary: the original side, W2-5a's `fidelityStdins` built under every retained reading of the pair index, which must agree (K26, K28; a disagreement refuses `input-invalid` `masking-snapshots-disagree fidelity` before the boundary's preflight), W2-5b1 Task 4's `preflightSpawn` (W2-D56 before every batch), three box-mode spawns (`payload`, `empty`, `user-text`) in one batch, W2-5a's `fidelityFigures`, and the verdict against part 1's tolerance, exactly in integers. A boundary whose original side or stdins are unmeasured spawns nothing; a run that failed makes its boundary unmeasured. `fidelity.json` is written and its sha printed on stderr; then, when a boundary did not pass or fewer than `n_fidelity` were measured (K13), it refuses `pilot-failed` (K3).
- **The judge-only gate (K25, D-6723).** One fully validated `spend.jsonl`, not a second ledger or a reserve: `batchGate` defaults to whole-ledger scope `all`; `openJudge` alone passes `scope: 'judge'`, still with `budget: node.budget`. The pure `judgeSpentOf` counts only exact `<section>/${JUDGE_DIR}/` prefixes for `ARM_SECTIONS`, after the entire ledger has been parsed. `judged.json.spend` remains `spentSoFar(out)` (whole ledger), and arms still count every row, including judge rows. Q5's share and printed line, `armNodeOf`, Q6's extrapolation and `spend_budget`, and `pilot_result`'s five fields are untouched. Both pilot and quiz are pinned here.
- **Agreed masking at each fidelity boundary (K26, K28).** The shared `fidelityBoundariesOf` takes `home`; for each boundary whose original side is measured it admits the store's retained readings (`const snapshots = maskingSnapshotsOf(rs, home);`) and builds `deps.stdins` under every one through Task 1's `maskingAgreementOf(snapshots, 'fidelity', …)`: the readings must agree run by run (or on one unmeasured word), else the boundary refuses `input-invalid` `masking-snapshots-disagree fidelity` before W2-D56's spawn preflight, so nothing of that boundary spawns or persists and `fidelity.json` is not written. Task 3's quiz fidelity calls this same loop with `home`.
- **The usage pilot (W2-D55, Q6).** It is W2-5b1's `arms --section pilot` and then `judge --section pilot` (the judge on the usage pilot's non-correct answers, Q6), in the same `--out`, each with `--step0b` when the fallback flow is in force (K2). This task adds no spawn for it: `pilot-result` reads what they wrote.
- **`pilot-result --section pilot` (C4; Q6, Q7, Q10; W2-D64, W2-D82; K3, K13, K15).** It reads part 1 (`gate_code` first), step 0b's result with its sha (Task 1's `passed`, `failed` and `unmeasured`, through `step0bOf`), and from `--out` the fidelity output, the usage pilot's arms summary, its judged file, the spend ledger and every recorded run's `run.json`. It writes the producer contract W2-5a's `pilotResultError` reads, `{kind: 'ccrc-history-w2-pilot-result', v: 1, fidelity, usage_extrapolation, step0b_sha256, settings_mode, absent_rate}`, plus `record_sha256` and `failures`, prints its sha, and then refuses `pilot-failed` when `failures` is not empty (K3):
  - `usage_extrapolation` records Q6's formula and its inputs: the margin 5/4, the pilot's question count, and the usage pilot's spend, arms and judge, read from the ledger by run name. It also records the extrapolation at part 1's `quiz.target`, the is_error reading (W2-D82, D-6644) at `usage_extrapolation.uptake`, and both spend readings with their measured relation (Q7). Part 2 copies it whole, so W2-D82's reading lives in part 2 at `pilot_result.usage_extrapolation.uptake.quiz_uptake` (K15), read through one exported reader, `quizUptakeReadingOf`, which W2-5b2's report calls;
  - `absent_rate` is W2-D64's guard per arm against part 1's `halts.absent_rate_max`, an arm with no answered question `unmeasured`, never 0;
  - `failures` lists every failed check (Q10): a fidelity boundary outside the tolerance or unmeasured, fewer boundaries than `n_fidelity`, an absent rate over the max or unmeasured, each check step 0b recorded failed or unmeasured, and a settings mode any usage-pilot surface ran under (read from its runs' `run.json`, its fidelity output and its judged file) that is not step 0b's (K13). A control exit 8 that is not `is_error`, or no control call at all, makes quiz uptake `unmeasured`, never a failure (Q10, W2-D82, D-6644).
- **`open --finalize` (C5, closing D-6280; Q6, Q27; K3, K14, K21).** The pilot result is bound to the part 1 it finalizes, as quiz-meta and power already are: a `record_sha256` that is not part 1's sha refuses `input-invalid`, naming both shas, before Q27's hold reads its failures, so another record's failed pilot is reported as another record's (K21). `spend_budget` is derived, `ceil(5 × n_questions × pilot spend / (4 × pilot questions))` in BigInt over the frozen list's entry count. `--spend-budget` stays the operator's echo of the approved figure (act 17), refused `args-invalid` on a mismatch. A failed pilot refuses `pilot-failed` unless `--accept-failed-pilot` is given; given, the pilot-result file's failures are printed on stderr (K14: part 2 keeps only `pilot_result`'s five fields), and the coordinator records the use in the ledger as the operator's act (Q27). The flag on a pilot that passed refuses. W2-5a's reader (`pilotResultError`) is tightened to the producer's shape and exported, so the producer's output is pinned against it.
- **Review 811's carries (the ledger's "For W2-5b2's plan").** F4: quiz-source refuses a part 1 `settings_mode` outside `SETTINGS_MODES` before `--out`, where it used to throw in `openWriter` after it; one spelling of the settings-mode row, `settingsModeRow`, for part 1 and for part 2's `pilot_result.settings_mode`. F2: W2-5a's threshold row asks 101 before 0, and its `max_age_ms` row uses a limits row stamped 30 s ahead of the clock, so each red under the range mutant is the `--out` hazard, not a word. F5: the unit case's title loses "and writes nothing" (it reads no path, so no write assertion could mean anything). F3: a precedence pin, a range-bad record on a home whose account is refused.

The driver never spells an arm word: every per-arm value is keyed by `RECALL_ARMS` at run time (W2-D42; W2-5b1 Task 1's scan holds it). `fidelity` and `pilot-result` take no `--allow-code-change` (Q23: a pilot act's remedy for a code change is a re-pilot, W2-D6).

**Choices (each the plan's reading of a ruling, measured by this task's cases):**
- **The fidelity verdict.** A measured boundary passes when `|replay_payload − original_payload| × tolerance.den ≤ tolerance.num × original_payload`, in BigInt (spec §10.2's ±25%, of the original). An unmeasured boundary never passes and is never a 0.
- **What `fidelity` spawns.** One batch of the three runs per boundary, `W2-D56`'s preflight before it; a boundary whose original side, stdins or a run is unmeasured or failed (a non-zero exit, a signal or no result event, D-6305's rule read for a fidelity run) is recorded `unmeasured` with its word, so a failed run never yields figures. The model is part 1's `arm_model` and the settings mode part 1's `settings_mode`, or step 0b's under `--step0b` (K2), as W2-5b1's `arms --section pilot` uses them (the "same flags" of spec §10.2).
- **The epoch rows.** "Its epoch's first call" is read as the first non-synthetic assistant row of N's own transcript (`entries.transcript_pk` = N's) in N's holding copy, before N. A row a resume copied in from another epoch is another transcript's and is not read.
- **Bodies read lazily.** `originalSideOf` reads a body only for the rows it inspects; a lost body there makes the side `unmeasured` `body-<word>` (the word `entryBodyOf` answers), never an empty text.
- **The usage pilot's spend is the ledger's.** Every line under `pilot/arms/` and `pilot/judge/`, a re-spawn's included (W2-D55's over-count is the budget's safe direction), read through `spendLinesOf`. A zero total refuses `input-invalid`: an extrapolation over no spend is never a 0.
- **K25 is not a hard token cap.** The approximate exposure is twice the node's share (pilot: twice `pilot_budget`) plus the token cost of in-flight soft-stop overshoot from up to `limits.concurrency` arm runs and `CONCURRENCY_MAX` judge runs. Concurrency bounds the number of concurrent runs, not each run's token cost; no strict total bound is asserted. Task 6 carries this disclosure and the PR residual. A judge exhausting its own share writes no `judged.json`; arms stopped on budget leave the node incomplete. Earlier ledger rows still count after a version move.
- **Q7's relation.** For each run name under `fidelity/`, `pilot/arms/` and `pilot/judge/` the ledger names, its `run.json`'s two raw readings are compared: result usage absent, below the assistant sum, equal, or above. A charged run with no `run.json` (stopped in flight) is `unrecorded`. Report-only. Only the sums saturate at the driver's clamp; the relation is never read on clamped readings, so two unequal readings past the safe range are never `equal`.
- **One halt rule (K3).** `fidelity` and `pilot-result` each write their file and print its sha on stderr first, so what failed is always recorded; then a failed check refuses `pilot-failed` (exit 2, Task 1's word), its detail naming every failure. `fidelity` fails on a boundary that did not pass and on fewer measured boundaries than `n_fidelity` (K13); `pilot-result` on any entry of `failures`. A re-run over the same `--out` reuses every finished run, writes the same bytes and refuses again. The operator's ruling on a failed pilot is `open --finalize --accept-failed-pilot` (Q27), which prints the file's failures (K14).
- **Step 0b's settings mode (K2).** One reader, `step0bModeOf`, called after part 1's own settings-mode row and before any store, spawn or `--out`: in `loadArmRun`'s pilot branch (after the pilot frozen list) for `arms` and `judge`, and in `fidelity` after the ranges. Without the pair it answers null and part 1's mode stands. With it, the result is read through `loadInput` (sha before parse), then `step0bOf` (`input-invalid` for a shape, a section other than `pilot` or another part 1), then `passed` (`pilot-failed` otherwise: a pilot act never runs under a step 0b that did not pass). `pilot-result` reads step 0b's result through `step0bOf` alone: a failed one is recorded, never refused on read, because recording it is the act's job.
- **A settings-mode mismatch is read from the runs (K13).** For each surface, the modes are the distinct `settings_mode` of its runs' `run.json` (`pilot/arms/`, `pilot/judge/`, `fidelity/`), plus `fidelity.json`'s and the judged file's own. Each mode that is not step 0b's is one failure, `settings-mode <surface> ran under <mode>, step 0b under <mode>`, so an arm batch run before the fallback switch is caught even though the arms summary names no mode.
- **`--accept-failed-pilot` on a passed pilot refuses** `args-invalid`, so the flag never becomes a habit. The `--spend-budget` mismatch is `args-invalid` too (the operator's argv disagrees with the record's inputs).
- **The order in `open --finalize`.** K21's binding follows the `pilot-result shape` check; the Q27 and budget checks follow the `q18-decision` check and precede `buildFinal`, so W2-5a's `maybe` case is unchanged and the window case's `--spend-budget 1` is re-pinned to the derived figure (e2).
- **No new driver word.** Every refusal uses a `DRIVER_REASONS` word that exists when this task runs: the halt is `pilot-failed`, which W2-5b2 Task 1 adds and classifies a refusal (K3: consumed here, never added), so the stop/refusal partition W2-5b1 Task 1 pins and Task 1 extends is unchanged by this task.

**Residuals, named:**
- `fidelityOriginalOf` does not prove that pilot-source's boundary belongs to the family it names; pilot-source wrote both, under its sha.
- A holding copy that does not begin at its epoch's start reads the copy's first call as the epoch's.
- `decimalOf` re-spells the gate's private `decimalFrac`; the parity pin covers the values it lists.
- The `not-error` reading counts any non-error control history call, a `ccrc history` call that never reaches the CLI (a `--help`) included.
- The relation over a stopped run is `unrecorded`; its charge stays in `pilot_spend`.
- `step0bModeOf` does not compare step 0b's `store_id` with the node's: the pilot runs on its one node, and `pilot-result` records a surface whose runs' mode differs.
- K25's separate judge-scoped stop may add approximately another share plus in-flight token overshoot; it does not make an incomplete arms node judgeable. Expected-spend extrapolation, all signed budget values and part 2's shape remain unchanged.
- A surface run under part 1's mode and then re-run with `--step0b` naming another mode on the same `--out` refuses `out-refused` `run-json-mismatch` (W2-4's `finishedOutcome`): those acts re-run on a fresh `--out`, `--step0b` naming the passed result where it lies (README, Task 6).

```ts
// ── W2-5b2 Task 2: fidelity, the usage pilot's result and the pilot's pure parts (W2-D76, W2-D64, W2-D82, W2-D55; Q6 to Q10, Q25; K2, K3, K13, K15) ──
// Every HOME is a mkTmp fixture made by W2-5b1 Task 4's w5b4Node (up-a, a fresh limits row, a tagged stamp) with the arm stub
// widened here, so a box-mode run prints the stream its stdin's first line names (B2T2_STUB). fidelity runs in-process with
// its three store reads injected; the store describe runs them for real over a swept store. No case spawns a real model,
// reads the live HOME or writes outside its own mkTmp trees. The test may spell the arm words; the driver never does (W2-D42).
import { describe as b2t2Describe, expect as b2t2Expect, it as b2t2It, beforeAll as b2t2BeforeAll } from 'vitest';
import * as b2t2Drv from '../../deploy/history-replay.mjs';
import * as b2t2Gate from '../../deploy/history-gate.mjs';

type B2t2R = Record<string, any>;
const B2 = b2t2Drv as unknown as B2t2R;
/** W2-5b1 Task 4's arm stub with one more branch: a print-mode run with no CCRC_RECALL_ARM (fidelity's box mode) prints
 *  `stub-box/<its stdin's first line, sanitised>.jsonl` when that file exists. Arm runs, judge runs and --version are as before. */
const B2T2_STUB = ((): string => {
  const old = `  process.stdout.write(per('.jsonl') ?? opt(${JSON.stringify(STUB_STREAM)}) ?? '');`;
  if (!W5B4_ARM_STUB.includes(old)) throw new Error('B2T2_STUB: W2-5b1 Task 4 stub line moved; re-anchor it');
  return W5B4_ARM_STUB.replace(old, [
    "  const boxKey = print && key === null ? stdin.split('\\n')[0].replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '-') : null;",
    `  process.stdout.write(per('.jsonl') ?? (boxKey === null ? null : opt('stub-box/' + boxKey + '.jsonl')) ?? opt(${JSON.stringify(STUB_STREAM)}) ?? '');`,
  ].join('\n'));
})();
/** The five fidelity boundaries the fixtures name (part 1's n_fidelity, W2-D76). */
const B2T2_B = [w5b4Gen(7001), w5b4Gen(7002), w5b4Gen(7003), w5b4Gen(7004), w5b4Gen(7005)];
/** A box-mode run's stream: init, one assistant message whose usage is `first` input tokens (W2-5a's firstCallUsage), and a
 *  result event unless `result` is false (a run with no result event failed, D-6305's rule). */
function b2t2Box(first: number, result = true): string {
  const ev: object[] = [
    { type: 'system', subtype: 'init', session_id: 'fixture-box-session', model: W5B4_ARM_MODEL, tools: ['Bash', 'Agent'], mcp_servers: [], plugins: [], skills: [], slash_commands: [] },
    { type: 'assistant', message: { id: 'msg-b2t2-1', usage: { input_tokens: first, cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, cache_read_input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 1 },
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'ANSWER: UNKNOWN' }] } },
  ];
  if (result) ev.push({ type: 'result', subtype: 'success', is_error: false, num_turns: 1, result: 'ANSWER: UNKNOWN', permission_denials: [], usage: { input_tokens: first, output_tokens: 1 } });
  return ev.map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n') + '\n';
}
function b2t2Plant(home: string, key: string, first: number, result = true): void {
  mkdirSync(join(home, 'stub-box'), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(home, 'stub-box', `${key}.jsonl`), b2t2Box(first, result));
}
/** Boundary entries `ids`, each planted to pass: 25,000, then 9,000 and 9,200 input tokens (a replay payload of 16,000
 *  against B2T2_ORIGINAL's 18,200, inside 25%). */
function b2t2PlantPass(home: string, ids: number[] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]): void {
  for (const id of ids) {
    b2t2Plant(home, `b2t2-${id}-payload`, 25000);
    b2t2Plant(home, `b2t2-${id}-empty`, 9000);
    b2t2Plant(home, `b2t2-${id}-user-text`, 9200);
  }
}
/** Step 0b's result in W2-5b2 Task 1's shape, the eight fields step0bOf reads (K4), saved outside any git tree; `passed`
 *  follows `failed` and `unmeasured` as Task 1's step0bVerdictOf makes it, unless `over` says otherwise. */
function b2t2Step0b(recordSha: string, o: { mode?: string; failed?: string[]; unmeasured?: string[]; over?: B2t2R } = {}): W5b4Saved {
  const failed = o.failed ?? [];
  const unmeasured = o.unmeasured ?? [];
  const mode = o.mode ?? 'restricted';
  return w5b4Save({ kind: B2.STEP0B_KIND, v: 1, section: 'pilot', record_sha256: recordSha, settings_mode: mode,
    passed: failed.length === 0 && unmeasured.length === 0, failed, unmeasured, ...o.over }, `step0b-${mode}.json`);
}
/** A fixture node (w5b4Home: store A) running B2T2_STUB as up-a. */
function b2t2Home(): string {
  const home = w5b4Home();
  writeFileSync(join(home, '.local', 'bin', 'up-a'), B2T2_STUB, { mode: 0o700 });
  return home;
}
/** pilot-source's output for w5b4Draft's part 1 (its seed, frozen sha, families and n_fidelity), with `boundaries` as its
 *  fidelity list and `over` replacing any field. */
function b2t2PilotSource(o: { over?: B2t2R; boundaries?: string[] } = {}): B2t2R {
  return { kind: B2.PILOT_SOURCE_KIND, v: 1, store_id: W5B4_STORE_A, seed: w5b4Hex('pilot seed'), n_fidelity: 5, n_usage: 5,
    families: [W5B4_PILOT], fidelity: (o.boundaries ?? B2T2_B).map((u) => ({ ...W5B4_PILOT, boundary_uuid: u })),
    frozen_sha256: w5b4Hex('pilot frozen'), writer_model: W5B4_OPUS,
    used: { labeller: { ...w5b4Gate.LABELLER, path_forms: [...w5b4Gate.LABELLER.path_forms] }, sha_min_prefix: 7, writer_input: 'excerpt',
      baseline_files: 'v1', writer_prompt_sha256: w5b4Gate.WRITER_PROMPT_SHA256, answer_protocol_sha256: w5b4Gate.ANSWER_PROTOCOL_SHA256 },
    code_shas: w5b4Shas(), release_stamp: W5B4_STAMP, budget: 3_000_000, spend: 900_000, counts: {}, ...o.over };

/** The original side every injected boundary measures: W2-5a's arithmetic fixture (12,000 in, 30,000 after the summary). */
const B2T2_ORIGINAL = { state: 'measured', firstInput: 12000, postInput: 30000, userRows: [{ text: 'please rebuild the fixture package', rawLen: 34 }] };
/** fidelity's three store reads, injected: boundary `B2T2_B[i]` is entry i + 1 (null when listed in `absent`); every stdin's
 *  first line is `b2t2-<entry>-<run>`, the stub's key. */
const b2t2Deps = (o: { absent?: string[] } = {}): B2t2R => ({
  resolve: (_rs: unknown, uuid: string): number | null => (o.absent?.includes(uuid) === true ? null : B2T2_B.indexOf(uuid) + 1),
  original: (): B2t2R => B2T2_ORIGINAL,
  stdins: (_rs: unknown, id: number): B2t2R => ({ state: 'stdins',
    stdins: { payload: `b2t2-${id}-payload\nthe payload\n`, empty: `b2t2-${id}-empty\n`, 'user-text': `b2t2-${id}-user-text\n` } }),
});
/** Part 1 (w5b4Draft, `draftOver` its overrides) and pilot-source's output, saved; a fresh --out; the fidelity argv, with
 *  `--step0b` when `step0b` makes a result for part 1's sha (K2). */
function b2t2Fidelity(home: string, o: { draftOver?: B2t2R; stores?: string[]; source?: B2t2R; step0b?: (sha: string) => W5b4Saved } = {}) {
  const draft = w5b4Draft(home, { over: o.draftOver, stores: o.stores });
  const d = w5b4Save(draft, 'part1.json');
  const p = w5b4Save(o.source ?? b2t2PilotSource(), 'pilot-source.json');
  const out = w5b4Out();
  const s0 = o.step0b?.(d.sha) ?? null;
  return { draft, d, p, out, s0,
    argv: ['fidelity', '--section', 'pilot', '--out', out, ...w5b4Inp('record', d), ...w5b4Inp('pilot', p), ...(s0 === null ? [] : w5b4Inp('step0b', s0))] };
}
/** An in-process call: stdout and stderr captured, a refusal answered as {word, detail}; any other throw is the case's failure. */
async function b2t2Call(fn: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<{ code: unknown; stdout: string; stderr: string; refusal: { word: string; detail: string } | null }> {
  const err: string[] = [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  const e1 = w5b4Vi.spyOn(process.stderr, 'write').mockImplementation(((s: string | Uint8Array) => { err.push(String(s)); return true; }) as typeof process.stderr.write);
  const o1 = w5b4Vi.spyOn(process.stdout, 'write').mockImplementation(((s: string | Uint8Array) => { out.push(String(s)); return true; }) as typeof process.stdout.write);
  try {
    return { code: await fn(), stdout: out.join(''), stderr: err.join(''), refusal: null };
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof b2t2Drv.DriverRefusal) return { code: null, stdout: out.join(''), stderr: err.join(''), refusal: { word: (e as B2t2R).word, detail: (e as B2t2R).detail } };

  } finally {
    e1.mockRestore();
    o1.mockRestore();
```
